plainSummary: A manual workflow run can still publish live to npm without cutting a GitHub Release.

findings.gap: Publish step sets DRY_RUN from `github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.dry_run || false`. On workflow_dispatch with dry_run=false, DRY_RUN is false and pnpm publish runs without --dry-run (live registry write) despite no release event. db092384-a2b9-8db4-b9b8-ff7b5e58f133 and 6f2b8a6c-e341-8ca2-84c4-d4427e03529a acceptance require live publish only on release published; dispatch may dry-run only. Fix: force dry-run whenever event_name != 'release' (e.g. DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event_name != 'release' }}), or refuse/exit 1 if dispatch requests live. Killer: packages/ledger/src/publish.workflow.break.test.ts::live publish only on release: workflow_dispatch must always dry-run (cannot live via dry_run=false).
findings.plainImpact: Anyone who can run the publish workflow manually could push packages to npm without a Release.
findings.fixProposal: Set DRY_RUN to true for every non-release event (recommended: `github.event_name != 'release'`). Keep dry_run input as documentation-only or refuse with exit 1 when dispatch asks for live. Do not let inputs.dry_run disable dry-run.
